instrument: Signal analyzer (Rohde & Schwarz FSIQ3 / FSIQ7 / FSIQ26 / FSIQ40)
source: Transcribed from the R&S FSIQ Signal Analyzer Operating Manual (1119.5063.12), chapter 6 Remote Control - Description of Commands. Same generation and layout as the FSU and FSQ manuals: column-0 headings carrying plain-word parameter clauses, Example / Characteristics / Mode labels, and prose-stated query exceptions, all of which the parser reads. The IEEE 488.2 entries are curated rather than extracted, exactly as the FSU's and FSQ's are: the common-commands section describes the set in prose the extraction mangles, inventing query forms for *CLS, *RST, *TRG and *WAI. *DMC, *GMC?, *PUD and *EMC are macro and protected-data commands the guide documents but the curated table does not carry, and they are left out rather than described from guesswork. This is a first extraction and has not had an adoption pass. Two things are known about it. Query forms are derived from R&S's stated convention — a query exists for each setting command unless the guide says otherwise — and this generation states those exceptions in a COMMENT column that pdftotext skews out of alignment, printing 'no query' against *STB? and 'query only' against *TRG, so the exceptions cannot be read mechanically and some derived query forms will not exist on the instrument. ABORt was corrected by hand from the ABORT the command-assignment tables spell and its invented query dropped, because the subsystem page states it plainly; the rest of the guide's per-subsystem COMMENT columns have not been read one by one. Five descriptions were page footers or softkey prose and were replaced from the pages they belong to.
